Faults:
Link failure between
EAP and MB2
Jammer
Corrective action:
Observe any faults reported
at LCU like TEMP and
FLOW errors. TEMP OK
and FLOW OK are the inter
locks to Switch ON the
power supplies of MB2
Jammer.

Check ETH SW2 and its
connections

Faults:
Tracking issue
during Track and
JAM command in
case of Deception
Jamming Technique
and Spot Technique
Possible Cause:
Track could be passive
on SCD
Corrective action:
For a given track and JAM
command for a particular
intercepted track on SCD,
observe the Track should be
in Active condition during
Track and Jam command.

Possible Cause:
Any obstruction to the
receiving Antennae
Corrective action:
Check there is no
obstruction on RX antenna
such that all the time RF
illumination should be on Rx
antenna and also Check the
functionality of Front End
Unit.

Check the cable between
ESI to the EA RACK-1 to be
connected properly
(Blanking signal from ESI to
the EA rack-1)

Faults:
Link failure between
RFC, NG and CIB
Corrective action:
Observe any power supply
failure in the LVPS-4 and
monitor the voltages in front
panel. if supplies found not
OK replace the supply.
